description: Keyed. A business states the payee, the corridor, the amount the payee must receive, and the deadline. Returns a proposal: bank, OTC, ramp, AMM and secure P2P wallet routes, including the business's own negotiated rate when one is on record. The selected route is the lower total the payer sends to land the full amount by the deadline. Each figure is measured, a public quote read at a date and not locked, or Being measured. SwapEazi does not hold or move money. A person still approves.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

amount_receive.description: What the payee must receive, in the to currency, greater than zero.

customer_id.description: Optional. Your own id for the customer, so its negotiated rate on record is included.

from.description: ISO 4217 code the business pays from, e.g. 'USD'.

payee_name.description: The payee's name, e.g. 'Lagos Steel Ltd'.

to.description: ISO 4217 code the payee receives, e.g. 'NGN'.

name: payment_intent
title: State what the business owes
